title: नेपालको  औपचारिक  शिक्षामा  राणा प्रधानमन्त्रीहरूको भूमिका
authors: के. सी. K. C., तेजबहादुर Tej Bahadur
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख नेपालमा औपचारिक शिक्षाको विकासमा राणा प्रधानमन्त्रीहरूले खेलेको भूमिकाको विषयमा केन्द्रित छ । नेपालमा औपचारिक शिक्षाको सुरुवात प्रथम राणा प्रधानमान्त्री जङ्गबहादुरको शासनकालदेखि भएको थियो । उनले राणा परिवारका सदस्यहरूलाई अंग्रेजी भाषा सिकाउने मनसायले सुरु गरेको अंग्रेजीभाषा कक्षा कालान्तरमा औपचारिक शिक्षाको आरम्भ बनेको थियो । प्रारम्भमा राणा परिवारमा केन्द्रित औपचारिक शिक्षा विस्तारै नेपाली जनसमुदायमा पनि विस्तारित हुँदै गयो । जङ्गबहादुरदेखि मोहनशमशेरको प्रधानमन्त्रीत्वकालसम्म यसको विकासक्रमले तीव्रता पाउँदै गयो । झण्डै ९७ वर्षको समयावधिमा औपचारिक शिक्षामा कुनकुन राणा प्रधानमन्त्रीहरूको के कस्तो योगदान रह्यो र थापाथली दबारभित्रबाट सुरु भएको औपचारिक शिक्षालाई सर्वसाधारणको पहुँचसम्म पुर्‍याउन कुन कुन समयमा के कस्ता प्रयासहरू गरिए भन्ने कुरा लेखमा समेटिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानमूलक लेख सहायक स्रोतहरूका आधारमा वर्णनात्मक विधिबाट तयार पारिएको छ ।
american_english: The present article is focused on the subject of the role played by the Rana prime ministers in the development of formal education in Nepal. The beginning of formal education in Nepal took place from the reign of the first Rana prime minister, Jung Bahadur. The English language class he began with the intention of teaching the English language to members of the Rana family eventually became the start of formal education. Formal education, initially centered on the Rana family, gradually expanded to the Nepali public as well. From Jung Bahadur to the premiership of Mohan Shumsher, its course of development gained momentum. What contributions were made to formal education by which Rana prime ministers over a time span of nearly 97 years, and what efforts were made at what times to bring formal education, which began from inside Thapathali Durbar, to the access of the general public, are covered in the article. This research-based article has been prepared through a descriptive method on the basis of secondary sources.

informal_english: This article is focused on the role played by the Rana prime ministers in the development of formal education in Nepal. The beginning of formal education in Nepal took place back in the reign of the first Rana prime minister, Jung Bahadur. The English language class he started up with the aim of teaching English to members of the Rana family eventually became the kickoff for formal education. Formal education, initially centered on the Rana family, gradually expanded to the regular Nepali public as well. From Jung Bahadur right down to the premiership of Mohan Shumsher, this development really gained momentum. What contributions were made to formal education by which Rana prime ministers over a time span of nearly 97 years, and what efforts were made at what times to bring formal schooling, which started inside Thapathali Durbar, within reach of everyday folks, are all covered in the article. This research article was put together through a descriptive method on the basis of secondary sources.
